description: NaGaF₆(Tl)₂ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Tl clusters inside a NaGaF₆ framework. In each Tl cluster, Tl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaGaF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-F bond lengths are 1.94 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Ga atom.
